name: _exit
description: The _exit() function terminates the calling process immediately, closing all open file descriptors and making its children inherit by init or the nearest subreaper. The parent process receives a SIGCHLD signal, and the exit status is returned to the parent.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The exit status of the process; the low-order 8 bits are returned to the parent process.

bugs: The _exit() function does not invoke atexit or on_exit handlers, may not flush stdio streams, and has implementation-dependent behavior regarding pending I/O and thread termination compared to the kernel system call.
